newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal to reintroduce money mkt certificates.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal to reintroduce money mkt certificates.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal will start using monetary intervention certificates again as a means of draining money market liquidity on a regular basis, a central bank official said.
"It will be another regular form of intervention for the Bank of Portugal." he said.

He said the certificates, which were last used in April, 1994, would have variable rates and that the central bank would begin using them today when it announces conditions for the start of a new cash reserves accounting period.
Initially the certificates will have maturities of four and nine weeks but these could be extended later.
